Indonesia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Jakarta, Indonesia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Sarajevo):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Diplomatic biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Citizens of the Republic of Indonesia are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.Citizens of Indonesia, the holders of diplomatic and official passports, are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit , transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
The holders of valid diplomatic or official passports of either Party assigned as members of the diplomatic or consular mission in the territory of other Party, including their family members namely the spouse (referring to husband/wife) and their unmarried and unemployed children under the age of 25 years, as well as dependent parents shall be required to obtain appropriate entry visa from the Embassy of the other Party prior to the entry.
